design_philosophy: High Energy Summer Festival. Think music festival posters meets tech speed. Vibrant, loud, sunny, and fast.

colors.usage_rules: Use Solar Yellow (#FFD700) for large backgrounds and main headers. Use Electric Blue (#007AFF) for 'Speed' related elements and Primary Buttons. Use Hot Pink/Orange (#FF4500) for 'Sale' tags and urgency.

layout_strategies.spacing: Generous vertical spacing (py-24 or py-32) between sections. Tight horizontal spacing in grids.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise texture overlay on the yellow backgrounds to give it a 'printed flyer' feel.

buttons.base: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-8 py-4 text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all transform
buttons.primary: bg-brand-blue text-white hover:bg-brand-blue/90 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] border-2 border-black
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-50 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] border-2 border-black
buttons.cta: bg-brand-orange text-white text-2xl px-10 py-6 hover:scale-105 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] border-2 border-black

cards.pricing: Ticket Style. Top section yellow/blue/orange, bottom section white. Separated by a dashed border. Sharp corners. Heavy black border.
cards.feature: Minimalist. Bold icon on top. Large heading. Small text.

generators.wrapper: flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-8 bg-white border-2 border-black p-8 shadow-[12px_12px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
generators.preview_area: bg-gray-100 border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden relative

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for UI icons (Sun, Wifi, Phone, Download, Check). Use thick stroke width (2px or 2.5px).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'html-to-image' or 'html2canvas' for the download functionality.
Create a 'PricingTicket' component that looks like a physical event ticket or coupon.
The Hero section must be EXPLOSIVE. Use the 'hero_bg' with a yellow overlay (mix-blend-mode: multiply or hard-light) to make it brand-compliant.
For the Generator: Create a live preview. When user changes text inputs, the Preview component updates instantly.
Use 'react-hook-form' and 'zod' for the contact form.
Use 'sonner' for success messages after download or form submission.
Ensure the A5 preview maintains the correct aspect ratio (148:210).
Instagram Post preview must be 1:1 aspect ratio.
Add a 'Download' button that converts the DOM node of the preview to a PNG/JPG.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for text. Keep it legible and bold.
Use high contrast colors. Black text on Yellow background is high readability.
Buttons should feel 'clickable' - use the shadow offset technique defined in visual_enhancers.
Spacing is key. Don't clutter the pricing tables. Use generous padding inside the cards.
Navigation should be sticky and high contrast (Black bg, White text or Yellow bg, Black text).
